purpose: Initial source reconnaissance for the native Ranvier Anime.js port
existingBindingBaseline: Anime.js 4.5.0, as documented by the current Ranvier.View bindings; exact upstream commit still to pin
confirmedFromDocumentation: Existing Fable bindings execute the JavaScript Anime engine and are not a native engine implementation.
The typed CSS bridge currently supports numeric custom-property tokens; broader CSS interpolation requires separate work.
The native coordinator checkpoint reports public Core alpha.55 and a still-qualifying matching Native/View successor.
decisions: Partas.AnimeJs is excluded by explicit user instruction.
Prefer typed CSS authoring and preserve native CSS interoperability.
Use compositor acceleration only where the runtime supports it and behavior is verified.
Keep protected Project 2 producers and shared tooling untouched.
nextResearch: Obtain the coordinator's recommended exact source baseline and native API entry points.
Pin upstream Anime.js source and inventory its complete feature surface.
Define behavioral equivalence checks for timing, interpolation, timelines, staggering, springs, controls and lifecycle.
Map SVG, scroll, draggable, text, layout and utility capabilities rather than silently narrowing parity.
Design the native engine and typed adapters before implementation.
verificationStatus: Source reconnaissance only; no native implementation, build, test or performance claim.
